title: A review of the developments in adsorbents for the efficient adsorption of ibuprofen from wastewater
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17843-17861
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02007G, Review Article
Open Access

Ahmer Ali Siyal, Radin Maya Saphira Radin Mohamed, Faizan Ahmad, Marlinda Abdul Malek, Majed Alsubih, Rashid Shamsuddin, Sajid Hussain, Sabariah Musa
Adsorbents used to remove ibuprofen were mostly mesoporous, and their adsorption capacity ranged from 0.220 to 497.3 mg g−1, and efficiency from 50–100%. The adsorption process was chemisorption, which formed a monolayer on the adsorbent surface.
